summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group filed a Form 6-K containing exhibits for a senior debt securities issuance, specifically forms for Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate and Floating Rate senior notes. The filing is a routine registration of debt terms and related legal opinions (Nagashima Ohno Tsunematsu and Paul Weiss). No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. This is a standard capital markets debt offering update by a foreign private issuer. The 6-K is incorporated by reference into an existing F-3 shelf registration statement.
